chunks: That was narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ullan from Muhammad ibn Hakim, who said: I asked Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him), 'Which is superior: recitation in the last two rak'ahs or tasbih?' He said, 'Recitation is superior.'
This indicates what we mentioned, that which was narrated:
ai.seo_question: Is recitation or tasbih better in the last two rak'ahs of prayer?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Rida (AS) clarifies the jurisprudential hierarchy between Quranic recitation and dhikr in the final two rak'ahs of prayer, affirming the primacy of recitation. It serves as a key evidence in Shia fiqh for prioritizing the recitation of Surahs over mere glorification, reflecting the emphasis on the Quran as the primary act of worship in these units. The report is cited from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, underscoring its reliability in establishing the preferred method of worship during the concluding phases of Salah.
